_about: Expected source pages per golden entry, as PDF page numbers (1-based), taken from the `source` field of data/golden_set.jsonl. Used for retrieval hit rate (document and page level) and for the oracle-evidence condition. Out-of-scope entries list the pages that show what the corpus does (and doesn't) say: the right behaviour there is to decline.
